note: Keyword sets for X recent search. Narrative-first: topics only, never accounts (from:, to: and @ are refused). A set runs only when its status is 'approved' by the NPCC Comms lead (workflow step W1.1). Queries use X search syntax; recent search covers the last 7 days.

sets.label: Fake police notices and curfews
sets.query: (police OR constabulary) (curfew OR "fake notice" OR "fake letter" OR "not from us") (UK OR Britain OR British OR England OR Scotland OR Wales OR London OR Manchester OR Birmingham OR Liverpool OR Leeds OR Glasgow OR "Home Office" OR constabulary OR "Met Police") lang:en -is:retweet
